item.title: Google Used AI to Rewrite a C Library in Rust: 30M GIFs Later, It Was Immune Before the CVE Even Existed
item.description: Google's security team rewrote the 3,000-line C image library giflib in Rust with Gemini, keeping the business logic free of unsafe. Validation wasn't a test run: 30M+ GIFs in a full regression, 200M+ differential fuzz iterations, adversarial AI review, and expert sign-off on every unsafe block. The best footnote: the original C version later shipped an out-of-bounds heap write (CVE-2026-26740) that migrated services were structurally immune to — before anyone knew the CVE existed.
